title: My First Taste of the World: Thailand

elements.content: Today I am inaugurating this diary to recap my very first ever international travelling experience. Before this, I had never seen an Aeroplan (other than in TVs and videos). I was thrilled to be seated near window in the plane for the first time.😃

elements.content: We visited Thailand after 2 months of our marriage. And within 4 hours we landed in Thailand, a beautiful country. We got picked up by a lady & were dropped at the hotel. On the same day before entering hotel, we visited King Power Mahanakhon Skywalk. We went up to 78th floor within 30-35 seconds 😍& witnessed lovely Bangkok city. Later, headed to hotel, rested a bit & then went to Sai tai Mai bus terminal for booking our bus tickets to Phuket. We had no other plans after that rather than going back to hotel, so we decided to explore Icon Siam a bit which was a luxury mall. Entire mall was of luxury brands which reminded me of BTS💜. After exploring entire mall up & down, back & forth, we decided to go back to hotel. So that’s when day 1 ended.

For Day 2, we had activities planned like Safari World, Marine Park & Jungle safari. I personally don’t like animal shows much, but I liked those shows. There were 5-6 shows & later after lunch we went to hotel to take a break because there was dinner cruise planned for us. I am being 90’s kid had only fantasized this cruise dinner thing. But when I got to experience one, I was super happy. I clicked so many pictures (well, I do that on every occasion). We had a wonderful 2 hours on the cruise. Post that we came back to room & slept. That’s how second day ended.

elements.caption: Standing on a glass bridge on 78th floor
I have always been a fan of those lights and vibrant ambience

elements.content: Thai people were sweet. Even though we did not know their language & they did not know our language, we managed to convey messages smoothly. But it was fun too to explain them. I felt like people there are so disciplined and so punctual about timings.

So, on our third day, we went for Bangkok city tour which was not that great. I mean it was just 2 temples & one gems gallery. That sight-seeing was least interesting for us. But anyway, it was a part of the package, so we had to go. We had KFC chicken after that & took cab for Bus terminal to go Phuket. We spent entire night in the Bus & After 12-13 hours of bus journey we reached another beautiful place called Phuket which was full of natural beauty🏝⛱ We were super exhausted by then, we rested at the hotel lobby & at 2 pm we checked in. The room was so beautiful with ocean view, I wish I can teleport there anytime. We were so tired that after taking a shower we slept thinking that will take quick nap & then we’ll go to explore Phuket on scooty which we had on rent for 2 days, but we slept for 6 hours (4pm-10 pm) & then after 10pm we went out for dinner. Tried Looking out for Indian cuisine & we got some which were expensive, we still had food there. It was 12:40am until we came back. That’s how day 4 ended.
I did not see horn honking, no lane cutting, no rude behavior, may be because we were tourist & that’s why they were behaving good, but my overall observation is they were well mannered.

elements.caption: City tour in Bangkok - That was one of the temple in Bangkok
This was the literal view from the hotel in Phuket😍

elements.content: Next day was the highlight of our Thailand Trip. We woke up & got ready only to miss the cab from hotel to the place where we were supposed to reach before entering speed boat. As I said, people were so punctual, they did not wait for us.😒 So, tour travel coordinator had to send another vehicle for us. That’s how we reached there. But after we entered the speed boat, I felt glad that this was included in our package

elements.content: because I was mesmerized by the ocean water, I was able to see the bottom of the ocean, it was that crystal clear. For a person like me who has only seen Virar Beaches, this was surreal experience.😍

I don’t know when & whether I will get a chance 
to see other beaches around the world but as of now, this is the no 1 in my opinion because of its white sand & clarity. We had many activities on that day & we were freed by the boat instructor by 6 pm so we reached to hotel by 8 pm.

elements.content: And that day also was hectic🥵, we wanted to lie down but we did not sleep because we had taken a scooty on rent & we wanted to retrieve as much as we could from night ride on the scooty. We rode our scooty across Phuket roads for 30-40 mins but eventually we decided to go home because next day was our Phuket city tour and check out from Phuket Hotel.

I got up early next morning, because we had to pack our stuff, handover the scooty, do our breakfast, check out from the hotel & then leave for the tour. Once again, we were little late for the tour, but Phuket city tour was a bit better than Bangkok City tour. This may be because we had more spots to cover in Phuket than in Bangkok & we also got more photos there. After all the sight seeing we took a shuttle bus which was a local bus, to reach to the downtown & then a taxi to reach to bus terminal which was approx. 1.5 hours away from the point where we handed over the scooty. We luckily got the bus that day since we reached there 5 mins before the departure. We got into the bus for Bangkok & left this picturesque city behind. And our day 6 ended.

elements.content: Next day, when we reached Bangkok, we walked down to Chatuchak market for shopping for our family members, 🚶🏻we shopped some bags, shirts, show pieces’, souvenirs etc. We had to spend time outside since our hotel check-in was 2pm. We explored entire market for 3 -4 hours & then left for our hotel. We were so exhausted because it was really hot just like Mumbai in peak summer☀️, but I didn’t care about tan. At that moment, what I cared about was how much money we have spent for Thailand, so I will see it as much as I can no matter how tan I become. But ultimately, I started feeling dehydrated.

elements.content: We went to hotel & ordered chicken biryani from the Indian restaurant which was on the opposite side of the road. That was the first time we had a good Indian food in Thailand from last couple days. We were so pleased with the taste of their food that we ordered our dinner from the same restaurant. We were so tired that day, we took it easy on ourselves & just relaxed in our hotel although we had 2 places to see. I just went to have message in the evening, after coming back to hotel we had our dinner, packed our bag & slept early because next day was our Checkout from hotel & we were going to leave for Mumbai. I did not want to leave because one week went so fast that I felt I did not get enough time. I wish I had more time for this trip. So next day we left from hotel at 6:30 am for our flight to Mumbai which was at 9:30 am. We reached home in the afternoon. And that’s where our trip ended.

elements.content:
I carried a lot of tan from Thailand, good memories of both the cities. I liked sweet & kind natured people, disciplined, punctual & respectful locals, not so spicy Thai food but tasty Indian food. I had seen lady cab driver for the first time, little washroom in the bus because of long distance travel, white sand, crystal clear ocean water, Phi Phi island, new country, speed boat, tiger, dolphin, sea lion, various different animals, night view & day view from the plane, road discipline, 2 years old cute Asian kid, cruise dinner, clean & spacious bus terminals, tuk-tuk vehicle, their go to shop 7 Eleven & many other things for the first time. I am very grateful that I could spend some time in country other than India in my life which I had never thought of. Imagining about international destination was not even in my dictionary but I still did my first trip. At this moment, I have not yet explored India enough, but I am happy that between this work & home, Nilesh planned this trip. I hope there would be many such trips in the future. This entire trip experience 
made me feel like we all are same, but just divided by language & culture. Well, I feel proud also that we went to a country where there was no room for communication, but we ended up gathering pretty good memories in such country as well.
